messages:
Devon: Hey team — two quick personal updates: I said yes (to Theo) 💍 and I start as Staff PM next Monday. Couldn't wait to tell you all! 🎉
Anya: WHAT!!! massive congrats ❤️‍🔥
Mina: omg congrats x2!! 🥳 When's the party? cake or dumplings? :cake: :dumpling:
Leo: wedding + promotion at once? legendary. free drinks pls 🍻
Ravi: congrats Devon! we'll do a potluck. I'm bringing samosas.
Poe: @Devon I booked the HQ kitchen for Tue lunch — 12:30 ok? I'll drop a calendar invite.
Devon: 12:30 is perfect, thank you!! Also, can someone volunteer to pick up a small sheet cake? low-effort hero award goes to you. :raised_hands:
Anya: volunteering to be hero but only if I get to put a cheesy caption on the cake. :grin: :tada:
Mina: poll time — react with your fave: :cake: for cake, :dumpling: for dumplings, :burrito: for burritos.
Leo: :burrito: (not even sorry)
Ravi: :dumpling: (but also samosas so maybe we need both)
Poe: quick poll link if people wanna be formal: https://forms.gle/celebration-poll — otherwise reactions work fine.
people-ops: Huge congrats Devon!! We'll handle swag and photos. DM us if you want a smaller/private thing too.
Devon: thanks everyone — honestly blown away. tiny preview of the proposal story: ring had a brief run-in with a burrito. full story at lunch, promise 😂
Anya: can't wait. bringing confetti (the sanctioned kind). :sparkles:
Mina: sending you both all the love. and congrats on Staff PM — so well deserved.
Ravi: cake logistics sorted if Anya is hero. I'm on beverage duty.
Poe: calendar invite sent to the thread. see you Tue 12:30! :calendar:
thread_text: Devon announced engagement and promotion; team coordinates a Tuesday lunch potluck celebration, reactions and a poll for food, logistics and a light anecdote about a ring and a burrito.
